notes: Breadboard bank mapping: the catalogue uses bank 't' = rows a-e and 'b' = rows f-j. In the image the upper half is labelled j-f, so it maps to bank 'b' and the lower half (e-a) to bank 't'. The rail the GND wire goes to is called 'tn'.
Each LED's anode is taken as the left (bent, longer) leg and its cathode as the right leg. The LED cathode column is joined to the ground rail with a short black jumper.
Rail hole indices (tn.1, tn.7, tn.10, tn.12, tn.15, tn.17, tn.20) are estimated from the image; all holes on a rail are one strip, so the exact index does not change the circuit.
Resistors straddle the centre gap: one leg in the f row of the upper half, the other in the e row of the lower half. Blue wires end in row d, in the same column strip as the resistor's lower leg.
Resistor value is 220 ohm as stated in the manual. Wiring is pin 7 to column 7, 6 to 10, 5 to 13, 4 to 16, 3 to 19, 2 to 22.
The schematic shows the Arduino GND connected to all LED cathodes. The picture does this with the ground wire to the rail plus the six black jumpers.
